description: Source code implementing JSON-RPC protocol functions, including message creation, response handling, method registration, and execution logic.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_message
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC message with optional ID and parameters.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_request
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request message with an ID.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_response_success
methods.description: Creates a success response message with ID and result.

methods.name: jsonrpc_create_response_error
methods.description: Creates an error response message with ID, code, message, and optional data.

methods.name: jsonrpc_is_response_success
methods.description: Checks if a response indicates success.

methods.name: jsonrpc_is_response_error
methods.description: Checks if a response indicates an error.

methods.name: jsonrpc_get_response_success
methods.description: Extracts ID and result from a success response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_get_response_error
methods.description: Extracts ID, error code, message, and data from an error response.

methods.name: jsonrpc_is_valid
methods.description: Validates if a JSON object is a proper JSON-RPC message.

methods.name: jsonrpc_get_method
methods.description: Retrieves the method name from a request.

methods.name: jsonrpc_init
methods.description: Initializes a jsonrpc_t structure, setting up mutex and request map.

methods.name: jsonrpc_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a jsonrpc_t structure, freeing resources.

methods.name: jsonrpc_register_method
methods.description: Registers a method handler with the JSON-RPC server.

methods.name: jsonrpc_execute
methods.description: Executes a JSON-RPC request, calling the registered method and generating a response.
